text:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: v1.15.0 -> prod-usw2. Canary 5% -> staged. Rollout ID: rl_b3f2. Runbook: ops.redwood/runbooks/postdeploy-verify.

sam: Quick alert 5 min ago from synth-agent: rerank-route synthetic failing latency budget, p95 jumped to ~1.6s, 5xx still 0. No error spike in logs.

rachel: Interesting. Is this affecting the main ranker or a variant?

sam: Affected variant = rerank-v2 (new). Traffic subset ~3% of canary. Baseline p95 ~430ms.

perf-bench: Could be KV cache coldstart or container scheduling on the new model. Suggest run focused smoke (+trace) against rerank-route, and temporarily remove rerank-route from canary target set while we triage.

eng-release: I don't want a full rollback yet. Can we pause the staged rollout and exclude the rerank-route from canary traffic programmatically? That would keep other routes progressing.

sre-oncall: Agree with exclusion. If we reduce canary weight for just that route to 0% it isolates impact. Escalate if 5xx > 0.5% or if error rate delta > 2%.

sam: Running smoke now:
```bash
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/rerank-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"q":"test document"}')
TIME=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/rerank-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"q":"test document"}' -w "TIME:%{time_total}s" -o /dev/null)
echo $HTTP_STATUS $TIME
```

sam: Smoke (pre-exclude): 200 TIME:1.58s

eng-release: I'll run the route exclusion command to take rerank-route out of the canary pool for now:
```bash
redwoodctl rollout exclude-route --rollout rl_b3f2 --route rerank-route --reason "postdeploy p95 spike" --duration 15m
```

deploy-bot: Action: route excluded from rollout -> rerank-route excluded for 15m by eng-release. Audit: audit_d9e1. Canary effective weight for rerank-route = 0%.

rachel: Nice. sam, can you re-run smoke and capture a flamegraph / span ids for the slow requests? Attach tracer link if possible.

sam: Re-ran smoke after exclusion (should hit previous model): TIME:0.45s, status 200. Captured span ids: span_33a, span_33b. Uploading short trace: https://traces.redwood/proj/trace/33a.

perf-bench: Trace shows long scheduler wait on the new variant (queue depth spike) and a cold KV miss for large documents. Looks like warmup needed. Recommendation: 1) Run targeted warmup for rerank-v2 with prefill script, 2) keep exclusion until warmup completes, 3) reintroduce at low traffic and watch p95.

eng-release: Agreed. Plan: prefill run (5m), then gradual re-add route to canary at 1% steps. If p95 > 1.2s after reintroduce, revert to exclusion and open rollback review. I'll add notes to rollout.

sre-oncall: I'll update the oncall pager policy for this rollout window. Pager suppressed for non-actionable p95 alerts but will fire on 5xx thresholds.

rachel: I'll add a line to the release notes and changelog: "rerank-route temporarily excluded from canary due to postdeploy p95 increase; warmup scheduled." Include trace link.

sam: Starting prefill now:
```bash
redwoodctl warmup --model rerank-v2 --route rerank-route --workload-file scripts/prefill_large.json --duration 5m
```

sam: Warmup running, monitoring logs.

perf-bench: After ~2m warmup, sampled smoke: TIME:0.62s. Approaching baseline.

eng-release: We'll hold exclusion another 10m to finish warmup and then reintroduce at 1% and watch 15m window. If stable, let rollout continue.

sre-oncall: Noted. Closing loop if stable for the next 30m.

rachel: Thanks team. I'll keep the changelog entry updated and add the perf snippet to the rollout artifacts.

deploy-bot: Reminder: excluded routes auto-restore after specified duration unless extended.

sam: Will post another update after re-add step.
